title: Training planning – Kaderblick documentation

hero.heading: Plan, run and review training completely
hero.lead: Manage goals, sequence, team, season and review through connected workflows.

body:
Open the session, verify context and understand the workflow

Training planning always extends an existing calendar event. Open the training in Calendar and select Plan training, Open plan or Run. Check team, date, time, venue and the Draft, Ready or Completed status. Work through Goal, Schedule, Team and Finish; mobile shows the current step. Confirm before discarding unsaved changes.

Set goals, season links and templates

Record the focus, detailed objective and preparation note, then assign relevant season goals. Applying a team template copies its blocks and equipment into this session; the copy is independent. Save a suitable plan as a new template, rename it or archive it. Template changes require an online connection.

Plan blocks, equipment and exercises

Add blocks with title, duration, intensity, objective and instructions. Move, duplicate or remove them and maintain equipment with quantities. Compare total plan duration with the calendar event.

In the Exercise library, search and filter by scope, club, team, age or player count. Review objective, instructions, duration, equipment and setup before adding an exercise. Authorised coaches can create or edit exercises and copy suitable volleyball exercises. Reload before resolving a concurrent edit.

Create a visual setup

Open the setup action on a block. Select a pitch, add players, coaches, goals, cones, balls, labels and movement paths, then position and edit the elements. Undo and redo are available, and keyboard help explains accessible controls. Save the setup on the block; the run view displays it read-only beside the instructions.

Review attendance and publish player information

The Team step separates internal planning from player-facing information. Review attending, maybe, declined and open responses and adapt group sizes accordingly. Enter the public goal, meeting information, items to bring and notes, then publish deliberately. You may publish an update or withdraw it. Saving the internal draft alone does not make information visible to players. Reload instead of overwriting a publication conflict.

Review the training week and copy a series

The week overview moves between previous, current and next week and identifies sessions without a plan, drafts, ready plans and completed plans. Open any listed plan directly.

For a saved plan belonging to a series, preview all destination events, select only the required dates and confirm the copy. Existing plans, skipped dates and conflicts are reported separately; the operation does not silently overwrite the entire series.

Plan the season and collaborate

Maintain season title, dates, phases and goals. Goals may use target dates, observation levels, training evidence or competition values. Record check-ins and review progress. On a version conflict, reload the current season plan.

For a saved, unfinished plan, assign lead, assistant or setup contributors, add comments and read the history of creation, edits, completion, publication, templates and series transfers.

Run training on mobile and offline

Mark a plan Ready only after it has a focus and at least one block. Confirm any duration difference. During the session, review context and progress, read the current goal, instructions and setup, record deviations, mark completion and move Previous or Next.

Offline mode keeps staged progress available. Reconnect before finishing. If online data changed meanwhile, choose deliberately whether to discard the offline changes or apply them; the application does not silently resolve the conflict.

Complete, export, analyse and reuse

Add an internal review when completing the session. The summary distinguishes planned, completed and skipped blocks. Reopening requires confirmation. Print plan / PDF opens the authenticated plan. Save a useful session as an independent template.

Analytics cover focuses, deviations, template use and reusable sessions within the authorised team scope. Opening a reusable session shows its source; it is not copied automatically. Empty analytics and loading failures are displayed separately.

Resolve permissions, loading failures and conflicts

  • Missing plan action: check event type, team, event status and edit permission.
  • Cancelled or deleted event: return to Calendar; do not create a duplicate.
  • Version conflict: reload and reapply the intended change deliberately.
  • Missing template or exercise: check team, club, sport, filters and archive status.
  • Missing series tools: save the draft and verify that the event belongs to a series.
  • Players see nothing: publish the player information explicitly.
  • Offline finish is blocked: reconnect and resolve queued changes or conflicts.
  • Load or PDF failure: use Retry; an error is never represented as an empty workspace.

Viewing, editing, publishing, collaboration and season planning may require different permissions.
